0022600008.text: Boston is 0-1 after its first game, a road loss, and sits 5th in the Atlantic Division and 15th in the East, one game back. New York is also 0-1 after its first game, a home loss, and is 4th in the Atlantic and 14th in the East, also one game back. Devin Carter is out for Boston with an illness, and the teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-3 in New York's favor, with the Celtics losing 112-106 in New York in their last meeting on April 9, 2026.
